method: built-in image_gen; reference-guided redraw, not official digital originals
promptBase: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE production illustration atlas, a perfectly regular 3-column by 2-row grid, square canvas ideally 2048x2048 or larger. Each cell is exactly 1/3 width and 1/2 height, portrait 2:3. Five illustrated character portraits, sixth bottom-right cell empty solid same background. No gaps or dividers, no text, no letters, no numbers, no card borders, no logos. This is a faithful crisp DIGITAL RESTORATION of the character designs in reference images, not a creative reinterpretation. Match their original small graphic hand-drawn cartoon illustration, pale faces and entirely black/shadowed hidden eyes, restrained flat colors, clean ink contours, few hard-edged shadows, simple shapes. Preserve identity, clothing, original objects, pose and proportions. NOT photorealism, NOT 3D, NOT ornate, NO golden trim, NO cinematic lighting, NO gradients, NO glossy AI concept art, NO realistic skin, NO paper grain, NO halftone dots, NO photographic blur. Each original character appears once centered in its own cell, head and torso fully inside cell with comfortable 10% safe margins. Solid dark-purple #252139 background for every cell. No extra objects or people. Source full-card photo is a supporting reference only: do not reproduce card lettering or paper texture.
